notes.title: We've Added New Starting Classes!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795732/d7c8dd827a9413e183f6ea50b8378a5e68e57f7b.png[/img]


We're preparing for our [b]upcoming playtest[/b]! We're excited to announce that we're adding a brand new profession selection system to our game. When you start your adventure, you'll be able to choose from a variety of classes, each with its unique starting weapon and abilities.


In our first phase, we're introducing seven classes for you to try out:

[list]
[*] Knight - Initial weapon equipped with a sword and shield, excelling in defense and close combat.
[*] Archer - Initial weapon is a bow, capable of unleashing a hail of arrows from a distance.
[*] Wizard - Wields the power of magic, using spells to attack enemies.
[*] Gunman - Initial weapon is a revolver, precision-aiming to take down enemies.
[*] Wild Caller - Tames and commands fearsome creatures, obeying your every command.
[*] Dark Knight - Wields dark magic, using a cursed sword to strike fear into enemies.
[/list]


Each profession will offer a distinct playstyle, so you can experiment and find the one that suits you best. Stay tuned for more updates, and get ready to embark on an epic adventure!


[b]Thank you for your continued support, and we can't wait to hear your feedback![/b]
